title: 115 People Vanished and Left Only One Word
description:
In 1590, John White came back to find his entire colony gone: more than 100 people, including his granddaughter. All that was left was one word carved into a post.
So what happened to the Lost Colony of Roanoke? The real answer is at the end.

All visuals are original illustrations made in code; scenes and maps are illustrative reconstructions, not archival footage. Narration uses an AI voice.

hook: In fifteen ninety, a man sailed back to America to find his entire colony gone. More than a hundred men, women and children had simply vanished, including his own granddaughter. There were no bodies. No graves. No sign of a fight. Just one word, carved deep into a wooden post. Croatoan. For more than four hundred years, nobody could say for sure what it meant. So what happened to the Lost Colony of Roanoke? Stay to the end, because the real answer is at the end, and archaeologists may have just dug it out of the sand.
